confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback pypdf extraction, Europe PMC full-text XML, two PNAS supplement PDFs, extracted supplement text, and rendered SI methods pages were reviewed. The supplement supplies stimulus, apparatus, condition, block, count, trigger/SOA, and EEG baseline details; remaining uncertainty is mainly exact loudspeaker model, exact ITI distribution beyond >2 s, and original tone file identity.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The study can be recreated as a passive near/far hand-centered audio-tactile ERP profile with tones, electrical tactile pulses, five condition rows, pseudo-randomized blocks, and explicit condition counts. It is static near/far stimulation, not looming motion.

source_checks.scope: Reviewed the main PNAS brief report for high-level paradigm, condition names, near/far distances, and SI Appendix pointer.
Reviewed Supplementary text pages 2-3 for stimuli, task, blocks, trial counts, trigger timing, and EEG baseline.
Checked the participant-detail supplement; it did not add Segment 1-4 task parameters.
Searched extracted SI text for auditory, tactile, condition, block, trial, inter-trial, trigger, baseline, and apparatus terms.
Europe PMC/PMC XML exposed supplement filenames; PMC proof-of-work cookie was computed to retrieve the supplement PDFs.
Temporary rendered SI methods pages were visually checked to repair text-extraction loss around near/far speaker placement.

review_attempts.result: Confirmed main-paper condition families, tone duration, and near/far distances, but found that detailed task mechanics were in SI.
Downloaded both PNAS supplement PDFs after resolving the PMC proof-of-work download gate and refreshed parser extraction.
Captured tactile pulse/device/intensity, auditory tone properties, block/count rules, pseudo-randomization, and trigger offset.
Verified near speaker <5 cm and far speaker 140 cm after fallback text extraction dropped part of the line.
Identified >2 s ITI, 40 ms auditory delay after tactile/trigger, and -0.5 to 0 s EEG baseline.
Mapped newborn 3-6 blocks of 5 trials per condition and adult 3 blocks of 12 trials per condition.

stimulus_type.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.2, Stimuli and experimental task
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The SI identifies the tone frequency and stimulus class.

source_provenance.value: Tones were generated with Audacity; exact original audio file is not supplied.
source_provenance.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.2, Stimuli and experimental task
source_provenance.evidence_note: Software provenance is reported, but no reusable sound asset is included.

trajectory_count.value: Two static auditory positions: near and far; used in auditory-only and audio-tactile rows.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The main paper names ANear, AFar, TANear, and TAFar conditions.

trajectory_path.value: Near speaker was less than 5 cm from the right stimulated hand; far speaker was 140 cm from the right hand.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: SI Appendix pp.2-3, Stimuli and experimental task
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Rendered SI pages verified the near/far distances and body anchor.

stimulus_duration.value: Tone duration was 50 ms, including 5 ms rise and fall times.
stimulus_duration.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.2, Stimuli and experimental task
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration and ramp timing are explicitly reported.

stimulus_speed.value: No auditory motion speed applies; stimulation used static near/far loudspeaker positions.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The paradigm is static near/far, not looming or receding.

auditory_conditions.value: Auditory-only near, auditory-only far, bimodal near, and bimodal far, plus tactile-only.
auditory_conditions.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The SI enumerates the five experimental conditions.

gain_envelope.value: Tone intensity about 64 dB; sinusoidal 50 Hz amplitude modulation; 5 ms rise/fall ramps.
gain_envelope.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.2, Stimuli and experimental task
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Intensity and amplitude envelope parameters are reported.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two loudspeakers controlled with a combined E-Prime-Arduino system; tactile pulses delivered by DS7A Digitimer.
renderer_or_apparatus.page_or_section: SI Appendix pp.2-3, Stimuli and experimental task
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Control and stimulation apparatus are reported, but speaker model is not.

trial_rows_families.value: Five conditions: T, ANear, AFar, TANear, and TAFar.
trial_rows_families.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The auditory/tactile condition rows are listed directly.

condition_intermixing.value: Trials from different conditions were intermixed in each block, with final counts matched across conditions.
condition_intermixing.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The SI describes condition intermixing and matched final counts.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Newborns completed 3-6 blocks; adults completed 3 blocks; order was pseudo-randomized with no more than two identical trials in a row.
blocked_or_random_order.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Block and pseudo-randomization rules are reported.

iti_jitter_policy.value: A long inter-trial interval greater than 2 s was used; exact distribution or fixed values are not reported.
iti_jitter_policy.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The SI states the ITI lower bound and rationale but not the full distribution.

response_window.value: No per-trial behavioral response window applies; this was passive EEG/ERP stimulation.

task_sequence_rules.value: Auditory stimuli occurred 40 ms after trigger in all auditory rows; in bimodal rows, auditory input followed tactile input by 40 ms.
task_sequence_rules.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The presentation-system delay is explained as task-critical timing.

tactile_stimulus.value: 200 microsecond non-painful transcutaneous square-wave pulses to right hand dorsum via DS7A and bipolar electrodes.
tactile_stimulus.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.2, Stimuli and experimental task
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Tactile modality, site, device, duration, and electrodes are reported.

soa_table.value: Bimodal auditory stimulus onset was 40 ms after tactile/trigger onset; no SOA ladder was manipulated.
soa_table.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
soa_table.evidence_note: The 40 ms offset is reported for bimodal and unimodal timing alignment.

baseline_strategy.value: Unisensory T, ANear, and AFar rows were used to form sums/control responses; EEG baseline correction used prestimulus interval.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The analysis contrasts bimodal responses with summed unisensory responses.

baseline_timing.value: EEG epochs used -0.5 to +1 s around stimulus trigger, with baseline correction from -0.5 to 0 s.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Epoch and baseline windows are explicitly reported.

catch_trial_type.value: No catch or no-go trials are described.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: The five rows are active unisensory or bimodal conditions.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Newborns: 5 trials per condition per block, 3-6 blocks; adults: 12 trials per condition per block, 3 blocks.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Per-block and per-condition counts are reported.

baseline_count.value: Unisensory control rows had the same per-condition counts: newborn 15-30 each, adult 36 each.
baseline_count.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
baseline_count.evidence_note: Counts were matched across intermixed conditions.

block_count.value: Newborns completed 3-6 blocks; adults completed 3 blocks.
block_count.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
block_count.evidence_note: Block counts are reported separately for newborns and adults.

total_trial_count.value: Newborns: 75-150 trials depending on 3-6 blocks; adults: 180 trials from 5 conditions x 36.
total_trial_count.page_or_section: SI Appendix p.3, Stimuli and experimental task
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Totals are derived from reported five-condition block counts.

critical_caveats: The exact original tone WAV is not supplied, although Audacity generation parameters are reported.
The speaker model is not reported.
The ITI policy is only reported as greater than 2 s, without exact distribution or fixed values.
Newborn trial totals vary by compliance across 3-6 blocks.
This is a passive ERP endpoint rather than a behavioral RT task.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence static near/far protocol source for Cell lineage and newborn/adult ERP profile recreation; exact ITI distribution and speaker model remain approximation points.
